gap_summary: The declared process requires protected application code changes on main to go through pull request review, but observed repository records show commits modifying protected code directly on main without linked pull request records.
missing_evidence: Emergency exception approval records for commits 8f31a2 and 91bd73, if any exist.

confidence.basis: The declared review rule and git history directly support process drift. Confidence is limited by possible missing pull request metadata or undocumented emergency exception approval.

limitations: CI passing does not establish review or authorization.
